gold: Bullous lichen planus of the nails

selector.rationale: The presence of lichenoid plaques, hyperkeratosis, hypergranulosis, acanthosis, basal cell degeneration, and dense bandlike lymphohistiocytic infiltrate in the histopathology results, along with the clinical presentation of painful swelling of the proximal nail folds and mucosal involvement, strongly support the diagnosis of Lichen planus.
